from typing import Any, assert_type
from townlet.training.replay_contract import PreparedReplay
from townlet.training.replay_buffer import ReplayBuffer
from townlet.training.prioritized_replay_buffer import PrioritizedReplayBuffer
from townlet.training.sequential_replay_buffer import SequentialReplayBuffer

def check_prepared_result(flat: ReplayBuffer, per: PrioritizedReplayBuffer, seq: SequentialReplayBuffer, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert_type(flat.prepare_serialized(data, expected_obs_dim=None, lineage=None), PreparedReplay)
    assert_type(per.prepare_serialized(data, expected_obs_dim=None, lineage=None), PreparedReplay)
    assert_type(seq.prepare_serialized(data, expected_obs_dim=None, lineage=None), PreparedReplay)
